title: Berlin, 1900, captured on film.
content: Crisp, colorized film footage shows bustling street life in Berlin and Munich in 1900 and 1914. (Direct link to video)Note: miniature car at 2:14,kids doing somersaults at 2:36,steam-powered vehicle in the upper right of the shot at 3:07,guy working a camera at 3:10.Thanks,Christian.
